newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Arts Optical IPO seen 200x subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Arts Optical IPO seen 200x subscribed - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares of optical frame manufacturer Arts Optical International Holdings Ltd in Hong Kong was seen about 200 times subscribed at close of application on Friday, market sources said.
An official statement on the subscription results will be made on November 5. Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on November 8.
Arts Optical is offering 84.5 million shares in Hong Kong at HK$1.00 per share.
Hambro Dah Sing Ltd is the sponsor, manager and lead underwriter of the issue. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
